subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Nobody's fool
solution:
The correct answer is '**Not easily deceived**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**nobody's fool**" means someone who is not easily deceived or tricked. (कोई मूर्ख नहीं)
 
• It implies a person who is wise enough to avoid being fooled by others.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The wisest person: It does not fit the context as appropriately.
 
• A complete fool: It does not fit the context as appropriately.
 
• All are fools: It does not fit the context as appropriately.
